title: közel van a X-hoz: "Close to X"

sections.title: Naming what something's near
sections.content: You already know közel van and messze van for "it's near" and "it's far", said on their own. Add -hoz/-hez/-höz to name exactly what it's near or far from — közel van a X-hoz says "it's close to X".

items.spanish: A park közel van a folyóhoz.
items.english: The park is close to the river.

items.spanish: A pékség közel van a hídhoz.
items.english: The bakery is close to the bridge.

sections.content: messze works exactly the same way — messze van a hídtól ("it's far from the bridge") pairs messze with -tól/-től instead, since "far from" needs the from-suffix, not the to-suffix.
